verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents launching a pod from a user-supplied Docker image or creating a custom machine template. It only mentions 'default templates' and Docker-in-Docker on every pod. Running containers inside a pod is a related but different capability, an adjacent workaround rather than custom image or template support, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment
